reviews.title: Great budget Shure lav replacement - decent sound quality for most needs
reviews.comment: For the budget, this microphone works great. It is a little larger size-wise but really not too large. I use lavaliers often for live and recording, and this really surprised me for sound quality for this budget range. If you need a mic for budget or a heavy abuse environment, I'd recommend
